snippet.title: You're My Favorite Person - Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist "You're My Favorite Person" on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3866380/Youre_My_Favorite_Person

YMFP is a short puzzle-based psychological horror game about you. After meeting a furry friend that lives in your computer, it takes you through several levels with puzzles for you to solve inside. Upon completing each level, you're granted a Perfect Star and get to go back...

BlueBen8 as the OG voice of "Friend"
